请选择要管理的预设: Please select a preset to manage

仅可使用字母、数字、点、下划线和连字符: Use letters, numbers, dots, underscores, and hyphens only
选中后直接使用预计算音色，生成时不再读取参考音频: Use precomputed voice conditioning without reading reference audio during synthesis.
拖入 .ivp 音色包以安装并选中: Drop an .ivp voice pack to install and select it
只能选择应用音色包目录内的文件: Only files in the application voice-pack directory can be selected
未选择音色包，将使用上方参考音频: No voice pack selected; the reference audio above will be used

制作完成后会自动安装到应用音色包列表，并选中该音色。: The finished pack is installed into the application list and selected automatically.
